sentences.en: Heart and blood-vessels are entirely absent; the blood is contained in sinuses which have no distinct walls or endothelial lining, and the principal of which are the perianal, the pedal, the visceral and the pallial.

sentences.en: Following tape perianal examination of 302 children, the overall infection rate of Enterobius vermicularis was 25%.

sentences.en: Methods 308 cases with perianal and perirectal abscess were treated by incision drainage and thread drawing therapy.
